name: Botanical Garden (Orto Botanico), Padua
description: Tucked into the city of Padua in northeastern Italy, this garden was founded in 1545 by the Venetian Republic and is still in its original spot, making it the world's oldest academic botanical garden. Its circular central plot, meant to represent the world, is ringed by water and framed by ornamental gates and balustrades. Run by the University of Padua, it remains a working research site.
